name: Break Tiles
author: Elw
description:
Break the red tiles to win the game! Move the paddle with the mouse or by touch. The ball is released on mouse up or touch up.

Note, that playing on a phone the phone needs to be horizontal. You do not need to touch the paddle to move it!

This is work in progress. So far no thrills, no frills.

Known issues:
- The sound cut off each other
- The ball can roll along the upper edge of the play area.
- When the ball just misses a tile it can produce a false "hit" sound
